Poslat na e-mail Úvodní představení Historie poradenské společnosti KNIGHT FRANK sahá až do roku 1896, kdy byla založena v Londýně. V současné době je jednou z největších mezinárodních realitních poradenských společností na světě, působící ve více než 488 kancelářích v 57 oblastech. V Praze fungujeme od roku 2001 a jsme součástí "mezinárodní realitní velké čtyřky" působící na lokálním trhu . Postupem času jsme přerostli rodinnou firmu, ale zachovali jsme si přátelskou atmosféru a skvělé vztahy uvnitř i navenek, díky čemuž jsme první volbou pro naše klienty. Svým klientům poskytujeme komplexní služby - investiční poradenství, oceňování nemovitostí, správu nemovitostí, zprostředkování prodeje a pronájmu nemovitostí. Pracovní nabídka Junior / Analytik oceňování nemovitostí (Valuation) HODNOTA NEMOVITOSTI NENÍ JEN ČÍSLO.Je za ní lokalita. Trh. Výnos. Riziko. A hlavně schopnost dát všechna data do souvislostí. V Knight Frank oceňujeme některé z nejvýznamnějších komerčních nemovitostí na českém trhu. Pracujeme pro banky, investiční fondy, developery i přední domácí a zahraniční investory. A právě teď hledáme do našeho Valuation týmu někoho, kdo chce pochopit, jak se skutečná hodnota nemovitostí tvoří. Pokud tě baví čísla, analytika a real estate a chceš se učit od zkušených lidí z oboru, čti dál. TVOJE NOVÁ KARIÉRAJUNIOR VALUATION ANALYST Nebudeš jen doplňovat čísla do tabulek. Postupně se naučíš celý proces oceňování komerčních nemovitostí – od sběru a analýzy dat přes práci s finančními modely až po přípravu profesionálních valuací pro klienty. Dostaneš se k reálným projektům napříč českým real estate trhem a budeš pracovat po boku zkušených kolegů, od kterých se můžeš učit každý den. A postupně budeš dostávat stále větší prostor a odpovědnost. CO BUDEŠ DĚLAT? Podílet se na oceňování kancelářských, retailových, industriálních, rezidenčních a dalších nemovitostí. Sbírat a analyzovat tržní data. Připravovat podklady a finanční analýzy pro ocenění. Spolupracovat na přípravě profesionálních valuation reportů pro klienty. Sledovat vývoj real estate trhu, cen, výnosů a dalších klíčových ukazatelů. Pracovat s databázemi a postupně také s profesionálními valuation nástroji, například Argus. Účastnit se prohlídek nemovitostí a postupně také jednání s klienty. Spolupracovat se zkušenými valuery i dalšími týmy napříč Knight Frank. KOHO HLEDÁME? Někoho, kdo má rád čísla. Ale zajímá ho, co se za nimi skutečně skrývá. Studuješ poslední ročník VŠ nebo už máš vysokou školu za sebou – ideálně ekonomického, finančního, real estate nebo stavebního směru. Máš analytické myšlení a práce s daty tě baví. Excel ti není cizí a chceš se v něm dál zlepšovat. Zajímá tě svět nemovitostí, financí a investic. Angličtinu zvládáš na úrovni, na které ji můžeš používat při práci. Jsi pečlivý/á a všímáš si detailů. Chceš se učit, ptát se a postupně přebírat odpovědnost. Předchozí zkušenost s oceňováním nebo Argusem je výhodou. Ne podmínkou. DOBRÝ ANALYTIK VIDÍ ČÍSLA. SKVĚLÝ ANALYTIK VIDÍ SOUVISLOSTI. V Knight Frank tě nečeká jen teorie. Budeš pracovat na skutečných nemovitostech a projektech, které formují český real estate trh. Dostaneš prostor učit se od zkušených kolegů, rozvíjet své analytické i obchodní schopnosti a postupně vyrůst v samostatného Valuera. Protože dobrý začátek kariéry není o tom vědět všechno. Je o tom být na místě, kde se toho můžeš hodně naučit. Proto aktuálně hledáme novou posilu do valuací, která bude společně s Terezou Peirson a Adamem Hyršlem řídit proces oceňování našeho mezinárodního portfolia nemovitostí a přinášet cenné insighty pro investiční i finanční rozhodování. Pokud se orientuješ ve valuacích podle standardů RICS a láká tě mezinárodní prostředí real estate investic, rádi tě poznáme. Co tě na této roli čeká? Koordinace pravidelného oceňování mezinárodního portfolia nemovitostí v souladu se standardy RICS. Spolupráce s externími valuátory napříč evropskými trhy a řízení celého valuation procesu. Kontrola ocenění, používaných metodik a klíčových předpokladů včetně analýzy změn hodnot jednotlivých aktiv. Příprava podkladů pro management, investiční rozhodování, auditní procesy a finanční reporting. Spolupráce s různými týmy: Controlling, Asset Management, Development a Project Financing. title: Corporate Finance Specialist
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we're building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen. If you share our passion but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow. At Stegra, we're not just building a plant, we're proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you. Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life. Corporate Finance Specialist We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Corporate Finance Specialist to join our growing finance team. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious finance professional who wants to play a key role in fundraising, capital markets activities, financial modelling, and strategic decision-making within a fast-paced and growth-oriented business. Working closely with the Corporate Finance Lead, Head of Corporate Finance, CFO, and senior leadership team, you will provide critical financial insights, support funding initiatives, and contribute to the company's long-term growth strategy. What you'll do As a Corporate Finance Specialist, you will support a wide range of strategic finance activities, including: Maintaining and enhancing integrated cash flow and financial models used for fundraising, forecasting, valuation, and business planning. Performing financial analysis, valuation assessments, investment appraisals, scenario modelling, and sensitivity analysis. Supporting debt and equity fundraising processes through preparation of financial materials, presentations, and analysis. Assisting with due diligence processes, coordinating information requests, and managing documentation requirements. Supporting financing transactions and capital markets activities, ensuring timely execution of key workstreams. Preparing reports, presentations, and analytical materials for Executive Leadership Team and Board meetings. Supporting lender and investor reporting requirements and governance processes. Monitoring financing obligations, covenant compliance, and financing-related risks. Analysing asset performance, forecast assumptions, and transaction trigger metrics. Partnering with Finance, Operations, Commercial, and other business functions to ensure consistency and quality of financial data and forecasts. Building strong relationships with lenders, investors, advisors, and key stakeholders. Contributing to the continuous improvement of financial models, reporting processes, and analytical tools. Who you are You are a curious and detail-oriented finance professional with strong analytical capabilities and a passion for solving complex business problems. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy working with senior stakeholders on high-impact projects. title: Pre-Sales Specialist Portfolio Management Solutions (m/f/d)
description: About Infront At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe's leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. About the Role We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially focused Pre-Sales Specialist to support the growth of our SaaS portfolio management solutions across Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands and Italy. Working as a trusted advisor alongside regional Sales Executives, you will engage with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle, demonstrating how our cloud-based portfolio management platform addresses the complex needs of investment managers, asset managers, wealth managers, family offices and institutional investors. This is a quota-carrying role with co-prime responsibility for the achievement of sales targets for the in-scope portfolio management product suite. Success requires a combination of strong business acumen, financial markets knowledge, technical expertise and the ability to articulate business value to both executive and operational stakeholders. As our Pre-Sales Specialist, you will: Partner with Sales Executives to develop account strategies and drive revenue growth across assigned territories. Qualify client business, functional, and technical requirements, contribute to opportunity planning and competitive positioning, and support commercial negotiations through solution expertise and value-based recommendations. Deliver tailored product demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical validation activities that address client objectives and investment workflows. Lead discovery sessions to understand client processes, challenges, and portfolio management requirements. Design and present solution proposals and architectures that align customer needs with product capabilities. Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on portfolio management solutions and industry best practices. Build strong relationships with stakeholders across investment, operations, technology, risk, and compliance functions. Present confidently to both technical and executive audiences, articulating the business value, ROI, and operational benefits of proposed solutions. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to support successful client outcomes and influence product development. Travel regularly across Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Italy to support customer meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal collaboration. Who you are Proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Engineering supporting enterprise SaaS solutions. Strong understanding of portfolio management, investment management, or capital markets operations. Experience supporting complex, consultative B2B software sales cycles. Excellent presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills. Ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions. Commercial mindset with experience working toward revenue targets or shared sales objectives. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technical stakeholders. Self-motivated and comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups. Knowledge of portfolio management platforms, investment accounting, order management, performance measurement, front-to-back investment platforms, cloud technologies, enterprise SaaS architectures, and RFP/RFI processes is advantageous. Fluent English and German are essential; French or Italian language skills are highly desirable. Professional qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, or equivalent are considered a strong advantage. Our Offer \\Health & wellness:\\ Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families. \\Holiday:\\ Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge. \\Pension:\\ Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions. \\Remote work:\\ Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location. \\Learning & development:\\ Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team. \\Culture & impact:\\ Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact. \\Our offices:\\ Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens. Additional notes \*Note: Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English. All candidates selected for employment are subject to pre-employment screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

title: FP&A Manager - Commercial Finance, £80K
description: FP&A Manager - Commercial Finance £70K - £80K plus bonus London Are you an ambitious FP&A professional looking for more than just a forecasting and reporting role? Do you want genuine exposure to senior leadership, the freedom to challenge the business and a clear route towards broader finance leadership? I am working with a complex, growing organisation looking for an ambitious FP&A Manager. You'll work directly with senior leaders, take ownership of major planning and commercial initiatives, and play a visible role in shaping decisions across a complex, multi-site business. For someone with the ambition to broaden their influence and build towards finance senior leadership roles, this offers significantly more than a traditional FP&A Manager position. What you'll be doing: Leading budgeting, reforecasting and financial planning across multiple entities and operational units. Analysing revenue, volume, labour, headcount and operational performance to identify trends and opportunities. Turning complex or loosely defined business problems into structured financial analysis and practical recommendations. Challenging operational and senior stakeholders on performance, assumptions and proposed actions. Reviewing Capex and Opex business cases, including payback, investment assumptions and benefit realisation. Identifying and tracking cost-saving and revenue-generating initiatives. Supporting senior management and Board-level reporting, including presenting the financial story behind performance. Building and improving financial models covering areas such as revenue, labour, headcount and cash flow. Working closely with Operations, Procurement, Transactional Finance and Financial Accounting. Supporting strategic and ad-hoc commercial projects. Improving FP&A processes, systems and automation. What we're looking for: We're looking for a qualified accountant ( ACA, ACCA or CIMA ) with strong experience across FP&A, commercial finance or finance business partnering. You should be able to understand a commercial problem, work through the underlying data, form a view and confidently present your recommendations. You'll ideally bring: Strong FP&A experience across budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis. Excellent commercial and business partnering capability. Strong Excel and financial modelling skills. Experience working with operational and commercial stakeholders. The confidence to challenge assumptions and hold stakeholders accountable. Excellent presentation and communication skills. The ability to explain complex financial concepts in straightforward language. Experience within a high-volume, operational or multi-site organisation. A strong interest in finance systems, automation and improving ways of working. Why consider this role? This is a particularly strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond traditional FP&A production and become a genuine commercial finance leader . You'll join an established finance function with strong accounting and FP&A support around you, giving you the opportunity to focus on higher-value work: challenging the business, improving forecasting, solving commercial problems and influencing senior decision-making. This role offers: Significant exposure to senior leadership. Close working relationship with the Head of Finance. Genuine influence across operational decision-making. Ownership of major UK planning and forecasting activity. Exposure to strategic projects and investment decisions. Opportunity to modernise FP&A processes and systems. Tato pozice je součástí oddělení účetnictví a financí a zaměřuje se na podporu finančního plánování, reportingu a konsolidace na úrovni skupiny, včetně centrálních funkcí a společností poskytujících sdílené služby. V úzké spolupráci s finančními týmy v různých zemích se budete podílet na sestavování rozpočtů, finančních prognóz, měsíčním reportingu a řadě projektů v oblasti Group Finance. Získáte široké zkušenosti s finančním výkaznictvím, konsolidací, převodními cenami a daňovou problematikou v mezinárodním výrobním prostředí. Tato pozice představuje skvělou příležitost pro kandidáty v rané nebo střední fázi kariéry, kteří se chtějí dále rozvíjet v oblasti skupinových financí. 💼 Hlavní odpovědnosti: Koordinace měsíčního finančního reportingu pro centrální útvary skupiny a společnosti poskytující sdílené služby. Podpora přípravy ročních rozpočtů, prognóz a dlouhodobých finančních plánů. Analýza finanční výkonnosti, identifikace odchylek a poskytování relevantních doporučení a obchodních poznatků. Příprava manažerských reportů a prezentací pro Group Finance a vrcholové vedení společnosti. Účast na procesu konsolidace a skupinového reportingu podle standardů IFRS. Podpora aktivit v oblasti převodních cen, včetně sledování mezifiremních transakcí a související dokumentace. Spolupráce na daňovém reportingu a projektech zaměřených na finanční compliance. Spolupráce s dceřinými společnostmi po celém světě za účelem zajištění konzistence a správnosti finančních informací. Zlepšování reportovacích procesů, finančních modelů a nástrojů pro plánování. Účast na mezioborových a mezinárodních finančních projektech. 👤 Požadavky: Vysokoškolské vzdělání v oblasti financí, účetnictví, ekonomie nebo příbuzném oboru. Přibližně 1 až 5 let zkušeností v oblasti FP&A, controllingu, účetnictví, auditu nebo korporátních financí. Zváženi budou i výjimeční absolventi. Dobrá znalost finančních výkazů a účetních principů. Silné analytické schopnosti a schopnost řešit problémy. Pokročilá znalost MS Excel; zkušenost s ERP systémy a nástroji pro reporting či konsolidaci je výhodou. Plynulá znalost angličtiny slovem i písmem. Proaktivní přístup, smysl pro detail a ochota pracovat v mezinárodním prostředí. Výhodou: Znalost standardů IFRS. Zkušenosti s procesy rozpočtování a finančního plánování. Zkušenosti v oblasti konsolidace, převodních cen nebo daňové problematiky. Praxe ve výrobní společnosti. title: Fachspezialistin/Fachspezialist Konzern-Treasury & Kapitalanlagen w/m/d
description: Die fenaco ist die grösste Agrargenossenschaft der Schweiz. Mit mehr als 80 Tochtergesellschaften sind wir in der Schweiz und Europa tätig. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass die wertvollen Schweizer Lebensmittel von der Erde auf den Tisch kommen – de la terre à la table. Der Fachbereich Konzern-Treasury funktioniert als interne Bank innerhalb der fenaco Gruppe. Er stellt die Liquidität und ein effizientes Cash Management sicher, berät und unterstützt Bereiche und Tochtergesellschaften in sämtlichen Finanzierungs- und Devisenfragen. Der Fachbereich Kapitalanlagen trägt die Gesamtverantwortung für die Bewirtschaftung des Vermögens der hauseigenen Anlagestiftung und stellt dessen professionelle Steuerung und Überwachung sicher. Die ausgeschriebene Funktion als Fachspezialistin/Fachspezialist Konzern-Treasury & Kapitalanlagen verbindet Tätigkeiten im Konzern-Treasury mit vielseitigen Aufgaben für die Anlagestiftung. Fachspezialistin/Fachspezialist Konzern-Treasury & Kapitalanlagen w/m/d Diese Aufgaben begeistern Sie Abwicklung von internen und externen Devisengeschäften Anlagereporting und Anspruchsrechnung für die Anlagestiftung Anlagecontrolling der traditionellen Kapitalanlagen Unterstützung des Anlageprozesses für traditionelle Kapitalanlagen Weiterentwicklung von Management-Tools Mitarbeit in funktionsbezogenen Projekten Administrative Unterstützung der Treasury- und Anlageprozesse Auf dieses Profil freuen wir uns Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) in Banking & Finance, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbare Ausbildung Berufserfahrung im Bereich Treasury, Fremdwährungsmanagement oder Kapitalanlagen Fundiertes Interesse an Finanzmärkten, Anlageprodukten und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse; SAP- und Bloomberg-Erfahrung von Vorteil Analytische, selbstständige und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit strukturierter Arbeitsweise fenaco Genossenschaft 100-100% Position Fach- / Führungsverantwortung Anstellungsart unbefristet Berufsfeld Finanz- und Rechnungswesen / Controlling Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess Stephanie Arni HR Business Partner Fragen zur Stelle Entdecken Sie Ihre Vorteile Aus- und Weiterbildung Wir investieren in die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden. Ein breites internes Bildungsangebot steht allen offen, und wir unterstützen externe Weiterbildungen. Attraktive Ferienregelung Unsere Ferienregelung garantiert allen Mitarbeitenden mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien. Ab dem 50. Lebensjahr sind es 6 Wochen und ab dem 60. Lebensjahr sogar 7 Wochen. Zudem ist der Kauf von weiteren Ferientagen möglich. Familienzeit Mütter erhalten während der 18 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub 100 Prozent ihres versicherten Lohns. Der andere Elternteil geniesst 3 Wochen Familienzeit bei vollem Lohn. Versicherungsleistungen Wir sichern unsere Mitarbeitenden mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozial- und Vorsorgeleistungen ab und bieten Sonderkonditionen auf Zusatzversicherungen bei diversen Krankenkassen für ihre gesamte Familie. Vergünstigungen und Rabatte Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren unter anderem von Rabatten beim Einkaufen und Tanken, von Gutschriften auf REKA-Geld sowie vergünstigten Mobile-Abos für sie und ihre Familien. Zentraler Arbeitsplatz Einen zentral gelegenen und bahnhofsnahen Arbeitsplatz in der Stadt Bern mit Möglichkeit zu Homeoffice Unser Bewerbungsprozess Die Bewerbung läuft ganz einfach über das Online-Formular – eine Eingangsbestätigung folgt automatisch. Nach sorgfältiger Durchsicht aller Unterlagen gibt's eine Rückmeldung, sobald die Vorauswahl steht. Gratulation! Das Dossier hat überzeugt und wir lernen uns bei ein oder zwei Gesprächen persönlich kennen. Passt es für beide Seiten, folgt ein verbindliches Angebot. Danach heisst es: Willkommen im Team und auf eine gute gemeinsame Zeit! Über uns Die fenaco ist eine Agrargenossenschaft mit 150-jähriger Idee. Mit über 11000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir unsere bäuerlichen Mitglieder bei der wirtschaftlichen Entwicklung ihrer Unternehmen. Wir sind in den Bereichen Landwirtschaft, Lebensmittelindustrie, Detailhandel und Energie tätig – de la terre à la table. Namhafte Marken wie UFA, RAMSEIER, Volg, LANDI und AGROLA: Auch das ist fenaco.

title: Treasury Lead
description: TL;DR: You will build Lovable's treasury function from scratch, working directly with our Head of Tax. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who knows how to set up treasury infrastructure in a fast-moving environment and wants to do it at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What we're looking for Lovable is scaling fast across multiple entities and geographies. As our first Treasury Lead, you'll work alongside the Head of Tax to build the treasury function from the ground up: investment strategy, cash management, FX framework, banking relationships, and intercompany structure. This is not a process-maintenance role. You'll be building, not inheriting, across a multi-entity, multi-currency business that is growing quickly. If you thrive in greenfield environments, find smarter ways to work, and want real ownership from day one, this is for you. You should have: Minimum 8+ years of treasury experience, ideally spanning cash management, investments, FX, and banking Experience setting up or significantly building out a treasury function, not just running one Strong understanding of cash investment strategies and risk management frameworks Hands-on experience with FX risk management and hedging in a multi-currency, multi-entity environment Background in high-growth tech or SaaS - you understand the pace and the lack of playbook Experience building and maintaining banking relationships and driving cost reduction across fees and transactions A genuine interest in AI tools and agentic ways of working - you look for smarter approaches, not just faster ones The ability to work independently and make decisions without a team behind you yet Excellent communication skills in English Based in Stockholm or willing to relocate What you'll do Build and own Lovable's investment policy and cash management framework across all entities Optimise yield on cash balances while maintaining appropriate liquidity and risk parameters Establish treasury infrastructure to support the business as it scales across multiple geographies and entities Build and implement an FX framework as international revenue grows Drive cost reduction across FX, banking fees, and payment transactions Build up and maintain banking relationships across the group Own daily cash visibility across all entities and banks Manage intercompany financing arrangements and ensure they are properly documented Partner with Finance, Tax, and Legal on treasury implications of commercial and structural decisions Build scalable treasury processes and actively explore how AI and automation can make the function smarter About your application Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Owner - Treasury Applications
description: Your role Do you want to drive the development and lifecycle of the Treasury application portfolio and lead digital transformation in Treasury processes across the organization? Do you enjoy working in an agile environment, close to internal customers, where new initiatives and possibilities are constantly emerging and the products are delivered and continuously improved to accelerate productivity of thousands of users? Come and join our team, Group Applications, in Atlas Copco Group IT! In the role of the Product Owner , your primary responsibility is to deliver and maintain Treasury IT applications , namely Trax, Quantum, and Multibank, in line with Atlas Copco's business needs while safeguarding system and data integrity. You also act as the technical subject matter expert for the Treasury applications, ensuring their compliant operation and ongoing stability. You may lead a highly motivated virtual, cross-regional team, delivering quality services for our internal customers. Your team will be a combination of internally assigned personnel and external service providers. Roles & Responsibilities Strategy Responsible for product portfolio positioning (vision, architecture, roadmap) Align with business stakeholders in setting priorities and driving product projects Develop and maintain product and technology roadmap Establish product governance structure Create Service Operating Model and define KPIs Develop communication strategy Solution Financial Management Demand to Delivery Responsible for designing, developing/acquiring, piloting, and delivering the Treasury products in line with Atlas Copco's group business needs Work closely with the regional teams and business stakeholders to identify, evaluate and align core business needs Prioritize development requests and ensure quality delivery Define technical aspects, plan resources, and create exit criteria of POC/MVP Monitor testing, plan product launch and ensure robust go-to-production procedure Prepare for Service Readiness: unit price, charge model, governance body, documentation Operation Responsible for maintaining the Treasury products in line with Atlas Copco's group business needs, leading technology solutions globally while safeguarding operational governance Design and implement product support process, including documentation and procedures for 1st, 2nd and 3rd level support Oversee supplier management and delivery quality of the Managed Services; Drive product adoption with support of regional delivery team Monitor and improve product performance (incidents, requests, usability, CSI, etc.) Improve customer experiences to enhance productivity Supervise change management and release management; lead rollout of the product and new functions Drive marketing, training and communication initiatives; manage business key users' community Ensure product compliance including access management, technical debt, and adherence to (local) regulations. Perform cost analysis and financial control with Business Control's support Implement Productized Way of Working under guidance of Architecture & Innovation team You will report to Group Applications Manager. Location Brno, Dublin, Shanghai, Stockholm - one of the following cities To succeed, you will need We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. If you have a strong foundation in IT applications, particularly in the financial domain, and are passionate about leading digital innovations, we encourage you to apply. Experience Requirements 5+ years of experience in IS/IT applications support and management in Treasury domain (finance domain is acceptable) Experience with Treasury processes and apllications in a large, complex, multi-location organization Experience with IT best practice / ITIL; ITIL certification desired Proven Project Management and business analysis capabilities Technical Skills Treasury Systems Expertise In-depth knowledge of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), particularly: Trax: Centralized payment processing and approval workflows, fraud prevention and risk controls, including rule-based checks and alerts, auditability, segregation of Duties, multi-level approvals, and access controls Quantum : Understanding of internal FX, loans, deposits, cashflow forecasting, in-house bank settlements, and month-end reporting. Multibank : Experience in configuring data, conducting testing with banks, and managing bank channel integrations. SWIFT Infrastructure System Administration Admin-level experience with Trax, Quantum, Multibank Managing access rights, compliance, and change/release processes. Compliance & Audit Readiness Familiarity with audit principles such as the 4-eyes principle. Ensuring systems are audit-ready and compliant with internal governance. In return, we offer A friendly, family like atmosphere. Have the flexibility and freedom to keep a healthy work live balance. Plenty of opportunities to grow and develop your own career path. A culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behaviour, and integrity. Potential to see your ideas realized and to make an impact. New challenges and new things to learn every day. Access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. Local benefits will be explained by local recruiters. Job location Location: Brno, Dublin, Shanghai, Stockholm This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office. Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Legal Counsel - Corporate Finance
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we're building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen. If you share our passion but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow. At Stegra, we're not just building a plant, we're proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you. Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life. Legal Counsel - Corporate Finance Stegra is seeking a Legal Counsel - Corporate Finance to join our Legal team and support both our equity financing activities and our large-scale project debt financing, together with more general corporate legal work. Reporting to the Head of Legal - Corporate Finance & Company Secretary, and working closely with our Lead Counsel - Project Finance, you will play a central role across the full spectrum of the company's financing activities, from equity raises and governance matters to debt documentation and compliance on our major project financing package, including ECA and public funding arrangements. This is an opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who wants broad exposure across both equity and debt finance, working alongside senior stakeholders on some of the company's most important legal and financial matters. It is also a unique opportunity to work closely across and learn from all financing aspects of a one-of-a-kind project with an interesting and extensive capital stack enabling an ambitious and meaningful project. As Stegra continues to grow, the role offers significant exposure to a broad range of legal and finance matters, close collaboration with senior stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape how legal support is delivered within a rapidly expanding international organization. Key Responsibilities As a fast-growing company with cross-over functions between teams, the scope of this role will evolve, however, core responsibilities include: - Supporting equity financing transactions, including capital raises, share issuances, stakeholder management and related governance and shareholder documentation. - Supporting the company's activities within M&A and joint ventures, including due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation and execution of transaction documentation. - Supporting the company's activities within off-balance sheet financing transactions and outsourcings. - Assisting with company secretarial matters, including preparing board materials, board resolutions, and compliance with governance documentation. - Supporting on the company's project debt financing, including loan agreements, security documents, and compliance with ECA and public funding conditions; as well as overseeing covenant compliance processes across multiple lending tranches. - Coordinating and managing direct agreements with project counterparties and supporting intercreditor arrangements and multi-party lender coordination. - Efficiently liaising with lenders' counsel, ECA counsel, technical advisers, insurance advisers, and other external specialists under tight drawdown deadlines. - Coordinating and building strong relationships with internal stakeholders (finance, tax, treasury, project delivery) and external parties (lenders, investors, law firms, ECAs, and regulatory bodies) on financing-related matters. - Monitoring ongoing compliance with financing covenants, reporting obligations, and regulatory requirements across both equity and debt workstreams. - Preparing summaries and reports on financing status, risks, and compliance for internal stakeholders and management. - Contributing to the development of scalable legal processes, templates, and playbooks to support the company's financing operations as it grows. Minimum Qualifications We are looking for candidates who meet the following criteria: - A Master of Laws (LL.M. or equivalent) with strong academic credentials. - Minimum 5 years of relevant legal experience at a leading law firm, within M&A, corporate finance, banking and finance, or capital markets. Relevant in-house experience is also a merit. - Demonstrated ability to independently manage transactional workstreams, from term sheet to complete documentation through drafting, negotiation, and execution. - Strong analytical and drafting skills, with a commercial mindset. - Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across both legal and finance functions. - A collaborative team player, comfortable working and learning across two related but distinct financing disciplines. Demonstrated ability to manage and organize high-volume transactional document sets, maintain accurate tracking of open items and workstream status, and coordinate effectively across multiple external advisers simultaneously, particularly under deadline-driven transaction timelines. - Fluency in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus. What Will Set You Apart: - Experience in both equity and debt financing transactions and M&A. - Experience in project finance, structured finance, or capital-intensive projects. - Experience with or exposure to joint venture structuring and negotiation. - Experience with or exposure to off-balance sheet financing transactions and outsourcings. - Familiarity with export credit agency (ECA) or public funding financing structures. - Experience with company secretarial or corporate governance matters. - Familiarity with project finance security structures, including pledges, assignments of contract rights, and direct agreements, and with intercreditor or coordination agreement mechanics in multi-tranche lending structures. Personal Qualities We value people who take initiative, build trust, and contribute to a collaborative workplace. You are curious, open to challenging established approaches, and treat others with respect. You are proactive, adaptable, results-driven, and able to prioritize and work independently with full ownership of your responsibilities. As a person you are likely independent, resilient, proactive and organized. You like to solve complex problems, work in a highly complex environment and have the a bility to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving business environment. Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you'll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We're building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive. You'll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it's permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature. Read more about Benefits at Stegra here. Our Stockholm Office Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you'll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city's energy and amenities.

title: M&A Manager
description: Aspia is looking for an M&A Manager to join Group Business Development and help drive our continued growth across the Nordic region. This is a hands on role in a lean M&A team, with broad responsibility across the entire transaction process. You will work on platform investments, add on acquisitions and selected divestments, from identifying opportunities and developing the investment case to due diligence, negotiation and completion. You will report to the Group Head of M&A and work closely with Aspia's Group Management Team, Country Managers and other senior stakeholders across the business. About Aspia Aspia is a leading Nordic provider of technology enabled accounting, payroll, tax and advisory services. Founded in 2018 under the ownership of IK Partners, Aspia was acquired by Vitruvian Partners in 2023. The Group has committed to delivering majority of its growth by 2030 through mergers and acquisitions, reinforcing the critical role of inorganic expansion in shaping Aspia's long-term strategy and value creation. The role You will take responsibility for the daily management of M&A processes across the Nordics. This includes: Identifying, approaching and evaluating potential acquisition targets Driving transaction processes with a high degree of independence and ownership from initial outreach through completion Coordinating financial, commercial, legal, tax and other due diligence workstreams Developing valuations and financial models, including DCF, LBO, comparable company and precedent transaction analyses Assessing transaction structures and supporting the negotiation of key commercial terms Preparing NBOs, LOIs, investment committee papers, Board materials and management presentations Turning strategic, financial and diligence findings into clear investment recommendations Supporting strategic and corporate development initiatives alongside core M&A responsibilities Managing internal stakeholders and external advisers throughout the process Qualifications You have 2-3 years of relevant experience from investment banking, corporate finance, private equity, in house M&A or a leading strategy consultancy and expect you to have: Strong financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills Experience working with complex processes involving several stakeholders and parallel workstreams The ability to form an independent view and communicate it clearly Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader investment case Confidence working with senior stakeholders, business owners and external advisers Excellent written and spoken Swedish and English Fluency in Swedish or another Nordic language is an advantage. Experience from business services, such as accounting, payroll, tax, audit, consulting or adjacent sectors, is also valuable but not a requirement. You are likely someone who enjoys taking ownership, works well at pace and is comfortable moving between detailed analysis and senior discussions. You are commercially minded, pragmatic and motivated by getting deals done, not simply analyzing them. You are able to drive complex processes with a high degree of independence and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Beyond transactions, you have a genuine interest in business, strategy and value creation, and are excited by the opportunity to contribute to broader initiatives across the Group What we offer You will join a high performing M&A team with a central role in Aspia's Nordic growth strategy. The position offers genuine transaction ownership, close exposure to senior decision makers and the opportunity to work across the full deal lifecycle. For someone looking to move from an advisory environment into a principal role, or to take on broader responsibility within M&A, this is an opportunity to see decisions through from the first conversation with an owner to the completed transaction. Does this sound like an interesting opportunity to you? If so, we look forward to receiving your application! You can easily apply by submitting your CV and answering a few screening questions directly in our recruitment system. Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email. Please note that selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation We strive to be world leaders in electric power by helping countries to have greener, stronger, and cleaner electricity by bringing sustainable energy to more and more people, we can reduce our impact on the planet. Oversees the proper application of contract and claim management methods in accordance with Hitachi Energy's policies, and contractual agreements. You will build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders of the PMO. Serves as an escalation point for individual and systemic project management issues. Reinforces and maintains a culture of Health & Safety in all project operations. Leads the PMO team to establish and enforce an effective project management approach to achieve both project and organizational goals. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Zou have extensive Project management experience with EPC component as well as In the electrical field You have deep knowledge about the execution of complex projects and about financial reporting. description: Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges As a Manager in the Tech M&A cohort of our Deal Transformation practice, you will advise corporate and private equity clients on the technology dimension of their most important transactions. Technology has become one of the defining value drivers in M&A—it shapes deal theses, influences valuation, creates integration and separation complexity, and ultimately determines how value is protected and delivered after close. With AI accelerating change across industries, you will help clients translate technology opportunities, risks and disruption into informed deal decisions and sustainable business value. How you will make an impact Technology due diligence: Lead assessments of technology landscapes, applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity, operating models and technology spend to identify deal-relevant risks and opportunities. Technology strategy and value creation: Advise clients on technology strategy, AI impact, operating model design and value creation opportunities throughout the transaction lifecycle. Technology integrations and carve-outs: Lead technology integration and separation planning, including Day 1 readiness, TSA considerations, target-state design and execution roadmaps. Technology cost and synergy analysis: Assess technology costs, investment requirements, synergies and execution complexity while working closely with financial and commercial deal teams. Client leadership: Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, private equity investors and technology leaders, leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes. Who we are looking for Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for solving complex business and technology challenges. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate technology topics into executive-level business insights. Bachelor's or Master's degree from a leading university. Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in M&A, technology strategy, technology transformation, transaction advisory or a related industry role. Strong stakeholder management skills, curiosity for emerging technologies, especially AI, and fluency in English. German and/or French is desired. Joining our team The Tech M&A team cohort within our Swiss Deal Transformation practice advises clients on the technology dimension of Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestitures, Carve-outs and Integrations. As part of Deloitte's end-to-end M&A advisory offering, we work closely with colleagues from Transaction Services, Valuations, Corporate Finance, Commercial, Strategy, Cyber, AI & Data and broader Transformation teams to provide clients with an integrated, value-driven approach to transactions. You will gain exposure to high-profile transactions across industries where technology increasingly determines value, risk and execution success. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you will help clients navigate complex technology decisions throughout the deal lifecycle while developing deep expertise at the intersection of technology and M&A. To strengthen our team, we are seeking, with immediate effect or by agreement, a committed, solution-oriented and strong negotiator to take on the role of Legal Counsel for ETH Zurich │ Space. Job description Your role at the interface between space research and law In this role, you will be the key legal point of contact for the research activities of ETH Zurich │ Space and ETH Swiss GeoLab. You will be part of a strong team of around 20 legal professionals in the Research Contracts Group, where you will benefit from their broad expertise and mutual exchange of ideas. Your personal focus will be on independently managing the space-related portfolio. Against the backdrop of a steadily growing number of collaborations, you will facilitate and promote the conclusion of contracts between ETH researchers and space-related organisations – ranging from industrial companies and start-ups to international space agencies, as well as academic and public institutions. You will advise researchers and management on the drafting and negotiation of complex research contracts and help to ensure that innovative research projects are implemented in a legally sound and efficient manner. This encompasses both traditional space technologies (e.g. hardware) and Earth observation, the processing of geo-information and the use of space data on Earth. You will support scientists with their projects from the initial idea for collaboration right through to the conclusion of a contract and lay the legal foundations for world-class international research in a highly dynamic environment. Poslat na e-mail Úvodní představení INVESTIKA, česká investiční společnost, přináší stabilní a dlouhodobě udržitelné zhodnocení prostřednictvím kvalitních aktiv napříč nemovitostním i kapitálovým trhem. Na trhu působíme více než deset let a díky důvěře našich investorů patříme mezi nejrychleji rostoucí realitní fondy v Česku. Pracovní nabídka Hledáme nového kolegu/kolegyni na pozici Analytik finančních rizik . Uvítáme jak zkušeného specialistu, tak i juniornějšího kandidáta se silným odborným základem a chutí se dále rozvíjet. Na pozici budete zodpovídat za systematické řízení oblasti finančních rizik, automatizaci jednotlivých procesů a datové analýzy. Budete součástí týmu řízení rizik, který zodpovídá za holistický přístup k řízení rizik napříč celou organizací. Čeká vás práce s daty, hodnocení rizik investičních fondů a shrnutí výstupů pro business. Co Vás čeká? Na pozici se budete podílet na pravidelné agendě a zlepšování procesů v oblasti finančních rizik: kontrola dodržování limitů u obhospodařovaných fondů, provádění zátěžových testů a výpočet VaR, řízení rizika likvidity, kontrola měnového zajištění, příprava ad hoc analýz. Vyhodnocování protistran , se kterými společnost spolupracuje, a pravidelná aktualizace jejich hodnocení. Příprava risk reportů pro plánované transakce s cílem vyhodnotit jejich dopad na rizikový profil fondu a soulad se statutem. Spolupráce na přípravě nových fondů z pohledu dodržení pravidel řízení finančních rizik. Tvorba a rozvoj modelů pro monitoring tržního rizika. Kontrola dodržování definovaných procesů a pravidel. Zpracování podkladů k reportingu pro vedení společnosti. Co očekáváme? Velmi dobrou znalost práce s daty a balíčku MS Office , zejména MS Excel a VBA. Znalost vizualizačních technik (zejména PowerBI) výhodou. Zkušenosti s řízením finančních rizik ve finančních institucích jsou výhodou. Vzdělání v oblasti ekonomie , financí či příbuzného oboru . Orientaci na detail , ale zároveň schopnost nadhledu a agregace informací. Analytické myšlení a schopnost hledat souvislosti v datech. Schopnost pracovat s daty a modely a převádět jejich výstupy do srozumitelných závěrů (pro prezentaci výstupů). Zkušenost přímo z oblasti řízení rizik je velkou výhodou, ale rádi dáme šanci i analytikům z příbuzných oblastí. Dodatečné informace: Nástup : ideálně od 1.10.2026, případně dohodou v jiný termín. Úvazek : plný úvazek (40 hodin/týdně). Lokalita : Praha 5, Anděl (Karla Engliše 4) - kompletně nové moderní kanceláře. Tým: budete součástí 5-členného týmu řízení rizik a pracovat přímo pod jeho vedoucím. V týmu budete spolupracovat také s kolegyní na obdobné seniorní pozici a s kolegy, kteří se specializují na IT security a řízení IKT rizik. Spolupráce : spolupracovat bude především interně s kolegy z oddělení obhospodařování (kapitálové trhy a transakční tým). Co můžeme nabídnout: stabilní zázemí rostoucí společnosti; odbornou roli s reálným vlivem na rozhodování; prostor pro kariérní růst a zapojení do projektů napříč společností. title: Junior Analyst to the Italian Trade Agency in Stockholm
description: Do you have good organizational and project management skills, speak Italian and English fluently and want to work in a role where you support the Italian Trade Agency facilitating the process of engaging investors from Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland investigating in Italy? Then this role might be right for you! This is a consultancy opportunity starting 1st - 31st of August 2026, with a strong possibility of extension. About the company The Italian Trade Agency (ITA) is the Italian government agency promoting the internationalization of Italian companies and attracting foreign investment to Italy. With a global network of 78 offices in 66 countries, ITA supports businesses through market insights, business matchmaking, and investment services. Its Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Unit assists foreign companies with every stage of establishing and expanding their operations in Italy, from location scouting and business setup to ongoing aftercare. Job description In this context, the Italian Trade Agency Office in Stockholm is seeking a motivated Junior Analyst for the Foreign Direct Investment Unit with a University Degree to support the FDI activities. The ideal candidate should be a person with analytical skills, used to scouring databases, the internet, and other sources to identify potential investors for Italian-based projects or similar business opportunities. The candidate, who will work under the coordination of the Director of ITA Office in Stockholm in connection with the FDI Division in Rome, will also be required to perform administrative and back-office tasks, as well as communication tasks and regular reporting processes. In this role, it´s important to be enterprise-oriented and have a client-minded attitude, with commercial awareness and strong client-oriented skills. Travels to Italy and abroad may be required. About the role During the Promotion Project, the candidate will support the ITA FDI team in order to facilitate the entire process of engaging investors interested in investing in Italy from Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland, building confidence and trust, even in aftermarket support. Primary responsibilities: • Support in the generation of leads through multiple sources, both online and offline, to maximize the outcome in terms of inquiries, active contacts, calls, and meetings. • Support in realizing reports, presentations, and documents to track, assess and disseminate the activities of the Unit through the existing ITA communication channels. • Organizing promotional activities related to the attraction of foreign investments, such as events, seminars, conferences, training courses, incoming trips of corporate players and investors to Italy and abroad. • Liaise with companies, investors, corporate players, other foreign and Italian counterparts, sharing news, solicitations, promotional opportunities and more. • Draft periodic reports highlighting potential opportunities for Italian companies. • Aggregate market research, industry resources, news, and articles as necessary to share with the team of the Office in scouting the FDI environment. For the implementation of those activities the candidate must have: • Good organizational and project management skills; ability to prioritize projects, manage time efficiently, work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and spoken; ability to produce reports, briefings, and memos on short notice both in Italian and English. • Ability to take charge of a project and run it to completion with minimal supervision; ability to identify issues and problems and solve them directly. • Good skills in the use of social media • Availability to travel in the Nordics countries and in Italy • Availability to work with different cultures, proactive attitude, and team spirit. Minimum Requirements • University Degree • Fluent Italian and English in speech and writing. • Remarkable computer skills • Tax residence in Sweden Preferential Requirements Preference will be given to candidates with the following additional skills and qualifications: • Fluent Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish in both speaking and writing. • University Degree and/or MBA and/or Ph.D. in International Trade, Finance, International Relations, International Business Law, or related subjects. • Two years or more of experience in investment promotion, or strategic consultancy, business law firms, finance, particularly in investment banking, or in sales activities. Contract term and Salary The selected candidate will be offered a fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension. The salary is fixed at 37.000 SEK/month. Interested? If the role sounds interesting, please apply today as we will process applications continuously. We are looking forward to receiving your application!

Lärcentrum är en nationell organisation där sektionen för Vuxenutbildning bedriver utbildning för Kriminalvårdens klienter. Vid varje anstalt i landet och vissa häkten finns ett eller flera lärcentrum där lärare undervisar på grundläggande och gymnasial nivå, motsvarande kommunal Vuxenutbildning, liksom utbildning i svenska för invandrare. Just nu söker vi två lärare till lärcentrum på anstalten Sörbyn. Hos oss på Sörbyn får du arbeta i en naturskön miljö med närheten till djur och hav, du har tillgång till personalgym och har möjlighet att köpa lokalproducerade produkter, allt från skärbrädor till mat. Arbetsbeskrivning Klienter som har behov av utbildning kan söka eller anvisas att söka till vuxenutbildningen. Undervisningen är individbaserad och sker på Lärcentrum. Som lärare inom Kriminalvården arbetar du i tre funktioner. För oss är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen samt tron på människans vilja och förmåga att utvecklas. description: En organisation i bevægelse. Nye muligheder i sigte. Og en central rolle i at skabe rammerne for det SOSU H, vi er på vej til at blive. Som landets største SOSU-skole har vi samtidig en ambition om at være med til at udvikle sektoren og gå forrest, når nye muligheder tager form. De kommende år bringer nye uddannelser, nye samarbejder og nye uddannelsesmiljøer og det stiller krav til både vores organisation og den måde, vi bruger vores resurser på. Derfor søger vi en ny resursedirektør. Du træder ind i en veldrevet organisation, men også i en organisation i bevægelse. EPX, et bredere og mere differentieret uddannelsesudbud og nye samarbejder åbner muligheder og stiller samtidig nye krav til økonomi, bygninger, teknologi, administration og organisation. Som resursedirektør får du et bredt ansvar og en central plads i direktionen. En af dine første opgaver bliver at skabe tydelighed om roller, ansvar og snitflader på resurseområdet. Rollen har hidtil haft mange tråde ind i uddannelsesområdet, og sådan skal den ikke nødvendigvis se ud fremover. Du får derfor reel mulighed for at præge både rollen og området og være med til at skabe de rammer, SOSU H har brug for i de kommende år. Økonomi og styring bliver en vigtig del af opgaven. SOSU H har taget de første skridt mod mere lokale budgetter og ønsker at udvikle økonomistyringen og skabe en tættere sammenhæng mellem aktivitet, bemanding, økonomi og ansvar. Samtidig venter væsentlige beslutninger om bygninger og kapacitet, ligesom der er brug for en tydeligere strategisk retning for IT, data, digitalisering og AI. Du kommer til en organisation med erfarne chefer og stærke fagligheder – og en kultur, hvor dialog og involvering har reel betydning. Vi tænker ikke meget i hierarkier, men i fælles løsninger, og vi forventer, at du både kan lytte, skabe relationer og sætte retning. Du skal have respekt for det, der fungerer, men også lyst og mod til at udfordre os og bringe nye perspektiver ind. Stillingen er for dig, der kan se helheden i et bredt resurseområde og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre. Dig, der har et sikkert blik for økonomi og styring, men som ikke kun ser organisationen gennem regnearket. Og dig, der har lyst til at være med til at forme de organisatoriske og økonomiske rammer om et SOSU H, der ikke står stille. title: Lärare till Lärcentrum A Ljustadalen
description: Om Kriminalvården Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter. Lärcentrum är en nationell organisation där sektionen för Vuxenutbildning bedriver utbildning för Kriminalvårdens klienter. Vid varje anstalt i landet och vissa häkten finns ett eller flera lärcentrum där lärare undervisar på grundläggande och gymnasial nivå, motsvarande kommunal Vuxenutbildning, liksom utbildning i svenska för invandrare. Vuxenutbildningen är nationellt sammanhållen och organiserad för att studierna ska fungera oavsett vilket verksamhetsställe en klient kommer till och även om hen förflyttas under studierna. Nu söker vi en lärare till lärcentrum på anstalten Ljustadalen. Arbetsbeskrivning Klienter som har behov av utbildning kan söka eller anvisas att söka till vuxenutbildningen. Undervisningen är individbaserad och sker på Lärcentrum. Som lärare inom Kriminalvården arbetar du i tre funktioner. Du undervisar dina studerande på anstalten Ljustadalen i lärcentrums lokaler och du kommer även att stötta studerande i rollen som pedagogisk handledare för dem som har sin ämneslärare på distans i myndigheten. Förutom det undervisar du även studerande på distans som studerar på andra anstalter. Detta gör att du i ditt uppdrag har kontinuerlig kontakt med och samarbetar med lärare och andra kollegor över hela landet. Allt arbete sker på anstalten. Kvalifikationer I din roll som lärare är du en skicklig pedagog med vilja och förmåga att motivera, entusiasmera och leda studerande att nå sina mål. Du är tydlig och engagerad i ditt arbete och har god förmåga att skapa struktur och systematik. Arbetet bedrivs både självständigt och i nära samarbete med kollegor, varför god samarbets- och initiativförmåga är viktiga egenskaper liksom att du kan arbeta självständigt. För oss är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen samt tron på människans vilja och förmåga att utvecklas. Kontrollen dækker alt fra almindelig bilagskontrol til transfer pricing kontroller og særlige kontroller omkring hvidvask, sort arbejde, uregistreret virksomhed, statuering af skattepligt for udenlandske selskaber m.v. Afdelingen varetager opgaven som kompetent myndighed i forhold til internationale aftaler samt udveksling af oplysninger til og fra internationale myndigheder. Toldopgaven omfatter kontrol af ind- og udrejsende samt ind- og udførsel af varer. Kontoret varetager også opgaverne omkring indførselsafgifter og ind- og udførselsangiver og forventes i løbet af efteråret at udvide kontrolopgaven på de øvrige afgiftsområder. Samarbejde med andre myndigheder Vi har et godt og tæt samarbejde med andre myndigheder og særligt med politiet, de nordiske toldmyndigheder og de danske skattemyndigheder I disse år har vi med stor politisk opbakning et særligt fokus på hvidvask og sort arbejde i både vores skatte- og toldkontorer. Stillingen Som afdelingschef har du det overordnede faglige og personalemæssige ansvar for afdelingen. Som afdelingschef har du desuden ansvar for at sikre høj produktivitet og kvalitet i opgavevaretagelsen. Du behøver ikke at være jurist, men skal kunne sætte retning, prioritere og sikre juridisk holdbare afgørelser på skatte- og afgiftsområdet, hensigtsmæssig driftsstøtte på it-området og hensigtsmæssig fordeling af ressourcerne, der sikrer at de lovbestemte opgaver bliver varetaget. Det sker i tæt samspil og dialog med medarbejdere, faglige specialister og relevante samarbejdspartnere. Faglige og ledelsesmæssige krav Vi forventer, at du er en erfaren leder med dokumenterede ledelsesevner samt indgående forståelse for og erfaring med offentlig forvaltning, politisk styrede organisationer og faglig viden inden for hele eller dele af afdelingens ansvarsområder. Relevant videregående uddannelse Stærke analytiske og strategiske kompetencer Evne til at omsætte målsætninger til konkret handling og styring Personlige egenskaber Ansøgeren forventes at have både nationalt og internationalt udsyn. Den rette kandidat besidder stærke kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner samt personlig gennemslagskraft. Stillingen kræver et synligt lederskab, som kan opbygge og fastholde en effektiv og driftssikker afdeling, der kontinuerligt udvikles og tilpasses organisationens behov. Derudover forventes kandidaten at udvise loyalitet, have en struktureret tilgang til sit arbejde og lægge vægt på menneskelige relationer og transparens, som grundlag for et godt arbejdsmiljø – både på ledelsesniveau og blandt medarbejderne i Skattestyrelsen. Vi tilbyder En spændende og vigtig chefstilling i Grønlands Selvstyre Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af kontrolopgaven i Grønland Et fagligt miljø med engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst for chefer i Grønlands Selvstyre Tiltrædelsesdato Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt eller efter aftale. Yderligere oplysninger Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til fungerende Afdelingschef Lisbeth Møller Jensen, tlf. 34 52 58, e-mail: lsmj@nanoq.gl . Ansøgningsfrist: 1. september 2026. Ansættelsesvilkår Stillingen er for tiden lønfastsat svarende til lønramme 38. Lønnen med faste løndele og eget bidrag til pension i LR 38 udgør pr. 1. april 2026 månedligt Kr. 64.048 og årligt Kr. 768.576. Der vil i udgangspunktet ske ansættelse på overenskomstvilkår, hvor ansøger i forvejen måtte være tjenestemand i henhold til tjenestemandslove for det offentlige Grønland, kan der ske ansættelse på tjenestemandsvilkår. For stillingen gælder, at ingen højeste tjenestetid er fastsat og, at bestemmelserne om ydelse af godtgørelse for merarbejde, og bestemmelserne om godtgørelse for mistede fridage ikke finder anvendelse, arbejdstiden er i udgangspunktet 40 timer ugentligt. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, herunder ret til til- og fratrædelsesrejse og bohaveflytning, i henhold til den på tiltrædelsestidspunktet gældende overenskomst mellem Grønlands Selvstyre og pågældende forhandlingsberettigede organisation. Bolig Der kan til stillingen anvises umøbleret personalebolig efter de til enhver tid gældende regler. Der kan ikke anvises bolig til personer, der i forvejen har en personalebolig eller en anden bolig ejet af kommunen eller Grønlands Selvstyre. Husleje og depositum betales efter de til enhver tid gældende regler for den anviste bolig. Personaleboligen er knyttet op på ansættelsesforholdet, og skal fraflyttes ved ansættelsesforholdets ophør. Husleje og boligstandard kan variere afhængigt af boligens alder, ejerforhold mv. Der kan være ventetid på anvisning af permanent personalebolig, hvorfor der kan ske indkvartering vakant, herunder også i mindre bofællesskaber eller hotellejligheder, for hvilket der sker beskatning. Det er ikke muligt at holde større husdyr eksempelvis hund eller kat i personale- eller vakantboligen. Indsend ansøgning, CV, uddannelses- og kursusbeviser, samt andre relevante dokumenter ved at trykke ”Send ansøgning”. Vi modtager ikke ansøgninger via e-mail. Om Naalakkersuisut Søger du udfordringer og har lyst til at præge hverdagen gennem dit arbejdsliv og være med til at forme fremtiden, så er et job hos Grønlands Selvstyre noget for dig. Vi forventer stor ansvarlighed og vægter faglige kvalifikationer, en sund analytisk tilgang til tingene samt omstillingsparathed højt hos medarbejderne. Herudover er din evne til at strukturere hverdagen og bevare overblikket vigtig. Grønlands Selvstyre består af en Centraladministration, med mere end 650 ansatte fordelt på flere departementer, samt en lang række decentrale enheder. Tilsammen er vi mere end 2500 mennesker tilknyttet Grønlands Selvstyre. Centraladministrationens opgave er, at sikre Naalakkersuisut (regeringen) et solidt politisk beslutningsgrundlag, samt at føre de politiske beslutninger ud i livet. Du kan læse mere om Grønlands Selvstyre på http://www.naalakkersuisut.gl/job

title: CFO till Lärandegruppen
description: Lärandegruppen är en av Sveriges största fristående utbildningsaktörer. Sedan 1999 har vi arbetat för att skapa möjligheter för människor att utvecklas och lyckas – från förskola och grundskola till gymnasieskola, yrkeshögskola och vuxenutbildning. Vi har en tydlig ambition att finnas genom hela utbildningskedjan. Vår övertygelse är samtidigt enkel: kvalitet kommer alltid först. Nu söker vi en CFO som vill vara med och ta Lärandegruppen vidare på vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa. För oss handlar det inte bara om siffror. Ekonomin är ett viktigt verktyg för att förstå verksamheten, fatta kloka beslut och skapa förutsättningar för fortsatt utveckling. Som CFO får du en central roll i att omsätta analys och ekonomisk insikt till affärsmässiga beslut – alltid med kvaliteten i verksamheten som utgångspunkt. Om rollen Som CFO får du ett brett och koncernövergripande ansvar i en verksamhet som befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas. Lärandegruppen omsätter idag cirka 1,5 miljarder kronor och består av ett tiotal bolag. Du leder och utvecklar ekonomifunktionen, som idag består av en controllergrupp och en redovisningsfunktion som leds av en redovisningschef. Funktionen är välfungerande och har ett starkt stöd i organisationen. Tillsammans med teamet fortsätter du att utveckla arbetssätt, analys och affärsstöd i takt med att koncernen växer. Du blir en viktig del av koncernledningen och arbetar nära koncernchef, dotterbolags-VD:ar och stabschefer. Rollen är både strategisk och operativ och du behöver trivas med att växla mellan långsiktiga perspektiv och konkreta frågeställningar i vardagen. Du ansvarar för koncernens ekonomistyrning, analys, rapportering och uppföljning samt för koncernredovisning, konsolidering och momsstruktur. Du utvecklar beslutsunderlag, prognoser, investeringskalkyler, analyser och bidrar med ekonomiska och affärsmässiga perspektiv i koncernens strategiska utveckling. I samband med förvärv och etablering av nya verksamheter blir du ett kvalificerat stöd och bidrar till att resurser och kompetenser används effektivt. Rollen omfattar även ansvar för ekonomiska principer, policies och centrala frågor inom bolagsformalia samt en viktig roll i styrelsearbetets ekonomiska delar och koncernens årshjul för styrelserapportering. Du hanterar även juridiskt relaterade ekonomifrågor i nära samarbete med organisationen och externa rådgivare. Som CFO är du en viktig ledare, både för ekonomifunktionen och som en del av koncernledningen. Du skapar tydlighet och riktning, samtidigt som du bygger en kultur präglad av tillit, samarbete och utveckling. Du ser dina medarbetares kompetens och skapar förutsättningar för dem att ta ansvar, växa och lyckas. Du är en trygg och närvarande ledare som vågar fatta beslut och utmana när det behövs, men som också lyssnar, involverar och förankrar. Du leder genom andra och får olika kompetenser och perspektiv att arbeta mot samma mål. För oss innebär gott ledarskap också att vara prestigelös, nyfiken och nära verksamheten. Vem är du? Vi söker dig som har civilekonomexamen eller motsvarande och gedigen erfarenhet från en kvalificerad ekonomiledande roll i en större eller komplex organisation. Du har erfarenhet av koncernsammanhang och är trygg inom koncernredovisning, konsolidering, ekonomisk analys och styrning. Du har gärna arbetat med affärsutveckling och strategiskt beslutsstöd samt förvärv, investeringar eller annan tillväxtrelaterad verksamhet. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av styrelserapportering och arbete nära styrelse och koncernledning samt av bolagsformalia, policies och ekonomiska principer. Erfarenhet av att utveckla ekonomifunktioner och medarbetare är viktig, liksom erfarenhet från tjänste- eller personalintensiv verksamhet. Erfarenhet från utbildningssektorn är meriterande. Det är också positivt om du har erfarenhet från kommunal eller annan offentligt finansierad verksamhet kombinerat med erfarenhet från aktiebolag. För att lyckas hos oss behöver du tycka om att samarbeta och ha ett genuint intresse för verksamheten bakom siffrorna. Du är prestigelös, jordnära och trygg i din kompetens. Du kan utmana när det behövs, men har samtidigt lätt för att lyssna, förankra och skapa förståelse. Du är analytisk och affärsmässig och kan göra ekonomi begripligt för människor som inte arbetar med ekonomi. Vi tror också att du har ett genuint intresse för skola, utbildning och människors utveckling. Lärande är en värderingsstyrd organisation, och vi söker därför inte bara en skicklig CFO utan också en person som vill vara en del av vår kultur och fortsatta resa. Varför välja Lärande? Vår framgång bygger på trygghet, teamkänsla och ständig utveckling. Hos oss är mod, nya idéer och kunskapsutbyte viktiga delar av vår kultur, och vi ser olikheter som en styrka. Sedan starten har vi gått vår egen väg och vi ser lärande som nyckeln till att möta en värld i ständig förändring. Genom nära samarbeten med näringslivet, branscher och andra aktörer lär vi för morgondagen. Som CFO får du en central roll i en koncern med starka ambitioner, där din kompetens och ditt ledarskap kan göra verklig skillnad. Sök till oss och bli en del av Lärande – där din insats gör skillnad! Läs mer om våra verksamheter på: https://www.larande.se/ Inom Lärande är vi stolta över att vi är certifierade enligt Great Place to Work® internationella standard. Läs mer här. Tjänsten är placerad på Lärandegruppens huvudkontor i Norrköping. Vill du veta mer? I denna rekrytering samarbetar Lärandegruppen med AS&B Executive. Välkommen att kontakta ansvariga rekryteringskonsulter, Conny Besterman 070-618 11 62 alt conny.besterman@asb-executive.se eller Veronika Otterborg 070-568 82 66 alt veronika.otterborg@asb-executive.se för mer information om tjänsten och processen. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 13 september!

title: Poseidon söker chef till Framtidens lönecenter
description: Är du chefen för Framtidens lönecenter? Framtidens lönecenter erbjuder en gemensam lönetjänst för Framtidenkoncernens samt även Higabkoncernens bolag. Du har en gedigen erfarenhet och förståelse för lönesystem samt erfarenhet av arbete i Shared Service Center/lönecenters med flera kunder eller bolag. Vi ser gärna att du har varit med och drivit förändringsarbete och processutveckling i form av införande av nya arbetssätt och systemstöd för lön i en större organisation. Du har en akademisk utbildning inom HR eller ekonomi alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom utbildning och erfarenhet. Du ser dina kunders behov och kan kommunicera på ett sätt som förenklar utvecklings- och förbättringsarbetet i relation till de som blir berörda. Vill du bygga Framtiden med oss? Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla en verksamhet och tillsammans med ambitiösa medarbetare och HR- råden i koncernen driva ett utvecklingsarbete för en långsiktigt säker och modern lönetjänst för Framtiden. Vi erbjuder en utvecklande och ansvarsfull roll där du har goda möjligheter att påverka och bidra till både verksamhetens och stadens utveckling. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att göra verklig skillnad för göteborgarna. Om oss Framtidenkoncernen är Göteborgs allmännytta och Sveriges största bostadskoncern. Hos oss bor var fjärde göteborgare. Våra fastigheter med drygt 76 000 lägenheter är värda ca 130 miljarder kronor, vi investerar årligen flera miljarder på göteborgsmarknaden och vi har cirka 1 300 medarbetare i koncernen som varje dag jobbar för att göra Göteborg bättre.

title: Privatrådgivare
description: Trivs du i en roll där du får utnyttja dina kunskaper som privatrådgivare för att ge kunden den bästa helhetsrådgivningen? Om du är nyfiken på att arbeta med kunder i hela Sverige i ett team där vi trivs tillsammans och skapar positiva kundupplevelser både på plats och på distans, läs vidare! Det senaste året har vår rådgivning främst skett digitalt, det är ingenting som har varit nytt för oss utan snarare en naturlig utveckling av redan befintligt arbetssätt. Danske Bank utvecklar ständigt nya lösningar och förfinar vårt arbetssätt, främst är detta drivet av nya kundbeteenden och samhällsutvecklingen. Det gör att vi har möjligheterna att verkligen fokusera på kunden och säkerställa en så bra kundupplevelse som möjligt. Om rollen I rollen som privatrådgivare får du möjligheten att ge rådgivning till kunder i hela Sverige med ett stort fokus på helhetsrådgivningen.
